Commercial window treatments in Los Angeles

Afternoon sun at a café table and glare on an office screen call for different solutions. We help Los Angeles businesses choose interior blinds and shades around the way people use the space.

Discuss your space(818) 884-5464

Keep the view. Soften the glare.

John’s commercial work has included mesh solar shades for Western Bagel stores in the Valley. Those shades let people see outside while reducing glare from the windows. John has also handled window covering work for The Izaka-ya by Katsu-ya.

Your space may need something different. We’ll talk about when the sun is a problem, what people need to see and how much privacy you want. That helps narrow the choice of fabric and treatment.

Offices

Consider desk positions, screen glare and privacy in meeting rooms alongside the look of the windows.

Restaurants and cafés

Think about the tables nearest the glass, changing daylight and the view customers enjoy from inside.

Street-facing spaces

Balance visibility from the sidewalk with the privacy and light control you want for the people inside.

Compare fabrics and controls in person

Screen shades are one option. Depending on the room, a roller shade with more coverage or a blind with adjustable slats may suit you better. We can compare materials and explain how they change the light and privacy.

We also help with measuring, installation and compatible motorized controls. Schedule a showroom visit or tell us about your space by phone or email, and we’ll discuss a useful next step.

Questions about commercial blinds and shades

Ask John: (818) 884-5464
Can you help with a small office or just a few windows?

Yes. Tell us about the windows and the problem you’re trying to solve. You don’t need a whole-building project to start a conversation.

Can commercial shades be motorized?

Motorization is available with compatible products. We can discuss controls for individual shades or groups of shades, along with installation and setup. The options depend on the products and system you choose.

What should I send for a commercial inquiry?

Photos of the windows, the business location and a short description of the space are helpful. Tell us whether glare, privacy or another concern is the main reason you’re looking at window treatments.

Tell us how your space needs to work.

We’ll help you compare interior window coverings for the people who use the room every day. Call John Crawford Company or email a few photos to begin.
